A survivor of the USS Liberty attack joins Tucker Carlson to tell what he says truly happened the day Israel hit the ship. The title also names the lies he says still cover it up. The attack took place in 1967 and killed 34 US sailors.

The survivor tells the attack as he lived it, hour by hour, from the deck of the ship. He argues the strike was no error and that US leaders helped bury the truth. Carlson asks why the case stays shut after so long. Listeners hear a grave first hand tale. The library keeps the talk as a record of his account.
